# Product Manager I
Corvid Health · Full-time

What you'll do

- Lead discovery with clinicians.
- Coordinate launches with sales and support.

Requirements

- 1+ years in product management or a related role.
- User research experience.
- Experience writing PRDs.
- Experience with Jira.
- Cross-functional collaboration with engineering and design.

Nice to have

- Healthcare domain experience.
- SQL.

What we offer

- Salary range $100,000–$130,000 plus equity.
- Health, dental and vision coverage.

Corvid Health is an equal opportunity employer. Fictional posting for RightStaff tests.
